Our client, a IT Services and Consulting company, is looking for a Salesforce Architect for their Juno Beach, FL/ Houston, TX location.
 
Responsibilities:
Platform Architecture & Customization

  • Define and govern enterprise Salesforce architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom platform applications — ensuring scalability, security, multi-org coherence, and long-term maintainability
  • Lead complex Salesforce customization efforts including Apex frameworks, LWC component libraries, advanced Flow orchestration, and platform event-driven architecture
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, DevOps best practices, and CI/CD pipelines via Salesforce DX, Git, and release management tooling
  • Drive architecture reviews, technical grooming, and platform health assessments across delivery teams and vendor partners
  • Own the Salesforce platform roadmap and align it to Client's IT strategic goals, operational priorities, and AI-enabled delivery models
Integration Engineering
  • Architect and govern end-to-end integrations connecting Salesforce to enterprise systems including MuleSoft, Documentum, Excalibur, SAP, GIS/ESRI, and legacy platforms
  • Define integration contracts, error handling frameworks, retry/resilience patterns, and middleware orchestration strategies for real-time and batch integration scenarios
  • Lead integration solutioning for complex, multi-system workflows spanning case management, document handling, and regulated utility operations
  • Collaborate with MuleSoft Architects to evaluate, design, and harden integration layers supporting mission-critical business processes
  • Guide REST/SOAP API design, Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), and event-driven patterns across multi-vendor delivery teams
Data Engineering
  • Own and drive Salesforce data architecture including data modeling, object relationships, schema governance, and master data management across multi-org environments
  • Lead data migration strategies from legacy platforms (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics) to Salesforce — including transformation logic, validation frameworks, reconciliation protocols, and cutover planning
  • Partner with the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) and Salesforce Data Cloud teams to design scalable data pipelines, harmonize data structures, and ensure enterprise-wide data integrity
  • Define and enforce data quality rules, deduplication strategies, and audit-ready data lineage standards aligned with NERC and utility-sector compliance requirements
  • Evaluate and guide adoption decisions between custom EDP approaches and Salesforce Data Cloud, presenting trade-offs with executive-level clarity
Generative AI & Agentic AI Delivery
  • Leverage Agentic AI platforms (Windsurf, Devin, or equivalent) daily for solution design, accelerated story creation, code generation, test automation, and technical documentation
  • Apply and champion prompt engineering best practices — iterative prompting, session scoping, output peer review, and token management — ensuring AI output quality and delivery completeness
  • Architect and integrate Salesforce Einstein AI, Agentforce, and GenAI-enabled flows into case management, portal, and enterprise automation workflows
  • Lead AI-augmented SDLC practices at the platform level, establishing guardrails, quality gates, and responsible AI usage standards for the broader delivery team
  • Drive and measure AI efficiency benchmarks including development velocity gains, BA/QA effort reduction, sprint throughput improvements, and labor cost optimization
  • Contribute to Client's AI-first delivery strategy, including adoption of REWIRE and Agentic AI tooling across the 2026–2028 Salesforce roadmap
Governance, Security & Compliance
  • Own platform governance protocols including user access management, permission sets, profiles, inactive account monitoring, and org health standards
  • Ensure all solutions adhere to NERC compliance, utility-sector regulatory standards, and audit-ready documentation requirements
  • Lead security architecture reviews, vulnerability assessments, and AppExchange product governance across Client's Salesforce orgs
  • Establish release management protocols, change control governance, and technical debt reduction programs aligned with platform long-term health
Collaboration & Delivery Leadership
  • Partner with business, product, and IT leadership to translate complex requirements into scalable, compliant, and high-impact Salesforce solutions with measurable business value
  • Work closely with Business Analysts and Product Owners to shape epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria — leveraging AI tooling to accelerate story creation by ~50% and reduce BA/QA effort by 40–60%
  • Lead, mentor, and develop Salesforce Tech Leads and developers across onshore and offshore delivery models, providing technical direction and removing delivery impediments
  • Serve as the primary technical voice in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, architecture reviews, backlog grooming, and retrospectives — driving engineering quality and delivery accountability
  • Coordinate with QA leads to define test strategies, support SIT/UAT, and sustain defect counts below the 5% threshold across platform releases
 
Requirements:
  • 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience with a minimum of 3 years in a Salesforce Architect capacity
  • Expert-level proficiency in Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL/SOSL, platform events, and Salesforce platform internals
  • Proven expertise in enterprise integration architecture using MuleSoft or equivalent middleware (REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware patterns)
  • Strong data engineering background including data modeling, ETL/ELT design, large-scale migrations, and data quality governance
  • Demonstrated daily use of Generative AI and Agentic AI tools in a software delivery context with measurable productivity outcomes
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and multi-org DevOps tooling
  • Salesforce Architect certifications: Application Architect or System Architect (required); Certified Technical Architect (CTA) preferred
  • Integration Architecture Designer and Data Architecture Designer certifications strongly preferred
  • Experience in regulated utility, energy, or infrastructure sectors with working knowledge of NERC compliance and audit requirements
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud, Einstein Analytics, Agentforce, and Field Service Lightning
  • Hands-on experience with Windsurf, Devin, or similar Agentic AI coding and delivery platforms
  • Knowledge of Documentum, Excalibur, or enterprise content management systems
  • Background in multi-vendor offshore/nearshore delivery models and vendor governance
  • MuleSoft Certified Architect or Integration Professional certification
  • Familiarity with GIS/ESRI integrations or geospatial data platforms in a utility context

title: Project Manager
description:
Our client, a IT Services and Consulting company, is looking for a Project Manager for their Remote location.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Plans and coordinates all aspects of technical projects from initiation through delivery.
  • Manages project initiation activities including identifying contractual obligations, client needs and goals, existing situation, necessary contacts and access to existing information as needed.
  • Ensures requirements for internal technology projects align to operational standards. Develops alternate requirements or document exceptions as appropriate.
  • Develops, defines and executes project plans, project scope, activities, schedules, budgets and deliverables.
  • Interacts with product development, sales, client relationship teams, technology solutions, service delivery and/or other cross-functional teams.
  • Identifies needed resources for projects, defines and assigns major project roles.
  • Coordinates activities and tasks among project team members, other internal departments and client or vendor/subcontractor organizations as needed to meet project goals and ensure project completion is on schedule, within budget constraints and of the appropriate quality standards for the project scope.
  • Assigns and monitors work of project team providing technical and analytical support and direction. Interfaces with external clients or field-based employees on technical matters as needed.
  • Manages project risks, issues/problems and activity progress to ensure project goals, e.g., deadline, scope and quality are achieved. Assists with problem resolution or risk mitigation as needed.
  • May manage the integration of vendor/subcontractor tasks and track and review vendor/subcontractor deliverables, if appropriate for the project.
  • May include customizing base products to meet client requirements, system integration with other FIS or third-party products or consulting projects and engagements.
  • Serves as liaison between technical and non-technical teams, in internal organizations as well as in client and vendor/subcontractor organizations to ensure all project targets and requirements are met.
  • Delivers informational and decision-seeking presentations to technical and business groups in FIS and/or in client organizations.
  • Conducts project closure activities to formalize and communicate the project acceptance, handover documentation and ongoing activities to accountable teams and complete a post-implementation review to identify areas of improvement.
  • Identifies project management coordination process gaps or areas for improvement, recommends and implements solutions.
  • Other related duties assigned as needed.

  • 11 Years of Experience
